source: PLAN.md 11.6 v1 option list. This table IS the whitelist: an option may change only the JSON-pointer leaves it lists (`*` = every array element, `[key=value]` = the array elements whose field equals the value). Ranges are authored game limits, not physics data: +-20 % final drive and gear ratios, +-30 % springs/dampers/ARBs/brake force, the brake bias moves the front share by at most max_shift around the stock one (same total torque). ABS/TC/ESC are not options yet (physics has none).

options.label: Final drive
options.help: Scales the final drive ratio. Higher = quicker acceleration, lower top speed.

options.label: Gear ratios
options.help: One factor per forward gear. Every gear must stay lower than the one before it.

options.label: Clutch
options.help: Installed clutch torque capacity. Higher capacity transmits more engine torque before slipping; changes apply when driving.

options.label: Brake force
options.help: Scales the torque of all four brakes.

options.label: Brake bias
options.help: Front share of the total brake torque; the total stays the same.

options.label: Springs front
options.help: Scales the front spring rate.

options.label: Springs rear
options.help: Scales the rear spring rate.

options.label: Dampers front
options.help: Scales front bump and rebound damping.

options.label: Dampers rear
options.help: Scales rear bump and rebound damping.

options.label: Anti-roll bar front
options.help: Scales the front anti-roll bar. Stiffer front = more understeer.

options.label: Anti-roll bar rear
options.help: Scales the rear anti-roll bar. Stiffer rear = more oversteer.

options.label: Tyres front
options.help: Any compound at any size this body's axle fitment allows (rim, width in standard steps, overall diameter). Width updates wheel geometry and inertia.

options.label: Tyres rear
options.help: Any compound at any size this body's axle fitment allows (rim, width in standard steps, overall diameter). Width updates wheel geometry and inertia.

options.label: Auto clutch
options.help: Default state of the assist.auto_clutch channel.

options.label: Auto blip
options.help: Default state of the assist.auto_blip channel (throttle blip on downshifts, upshift cut).

options.label: Automatic gearbox
options.help: Default state of the assist.auto_shift channel.

options.label: Driver assists
options.help: The car's assist electronics (physics_sim assist unit). Street offers traction control Off/On; Sport adds the Relaxed and Sport modes; Racing adds Drift and the rear-wing automation. The F4 key cycles only through the modes the fitted unit offers.

parts.label: Street Assists
parts.detail: Traction control: Off, On. No wing automation.

parts.label: Sport Assists
parts.detail: Traction control: Off, On, Relaxed, Sport. No wing automation.

parts.label: Racing Assists
parts.detail: Traction control: Off, On, Relaxed, Sport, Drift. Rear-wing automation.

options.label: Paint
options.help: Body colour. Visual only.

options.label: Rims
options.help: Rim colour. Visual only.

options.label: Folding top
options.help: Fit the fabric top. Shown on the model only: its weight and drag are not in the physics yet.

options.label: Rev limiter
options.help: Engine rev limit in rpm, 2000 to 20000 on a logarithmic slider. Above the stock limit the engine may leave its data range or run its pistons too fast: the setup check warns about both. Stored as a multiple of the installed engine's own limit.

options.label: Throttle response time
options.help: Time constant of the electronic throttle actuator, 20 to 100 ms. Lower responds faster; higher smooths pedal changes. Available only on engines with an electronic actuator.

options.label: Engine
options.help: Install any engine of the garage list (the shipped engines and your own). The swap derives the fuel, clutch capacity, clutch and shift points and the car's weight from the new engine; the lines under the list say what changed. The ids of the first version of this option (sedan_i4, sedan_i6) still resolve.

options.label: Fuel
options.help: The fuel in the tank, limited to the fuels the installed engine lists; the first is its reference fuel. A swap keeps the current fuel if the new engine lists it.

options.label: Gearbox
options.help: Swap the gearbox. Manual boxes (and the sequential ones) are listed; automatic and CVT follow once the physics supports them. A box is offered only if its torque rating covers the installed engine's peak torque; the car's own box is always there. The box brings its own gear ratios (the gear ratio sliders then scale them), the shift points of the auto-shift assist stay.
